svg.title: Departures — ehosta
svg.desc: MD 449 to FT_TRANSCENDANCE, boarding; EH 427 to 42-INCEPTION, delayed; EH 989 to BRAINFXCKER, delayed; EH 426 to 42-HOTRACE, delayed; EH 429 to 42-ALCU, delayed; EH 424 to 42-WEBSERV, delayed; EH 422 to 42-FT_SHMUP, delayed; EH 421 to 42-LIBUNIT, delayed; SU 957 to SPINUP, delayed; EH 429 to 42-CPP_09, delayed; EH 421 to 42-CUB3D, departed; EH 426 to 42-PHILOSOPHERS, departed; EH 421 to 42-MINISHELL, departed

g.text: TIME
DESTINATION
FLIGHT
GATE
REMARKS
CODESHARE WITH MDOURDOI · SPINUP-CLI
MD 449 FT_TRANSCENDANCE — ft_transcendance for 42 school
EH 427 42-INCEPTION — My personal Inception for Milestone 5. Let's learn Docker!
EH 989 BRAINFXCKER — Have you ever dreamt about compiling Brainfuck? No? Well, it is now possible.
EH 426 42-HOTRACE — Our own Hotraces for the Rushes. Fast and efficient research!
EH 429 42-ALCU — Our own AlCu for the Rushes. Don't be the last one to pick the cat!
EH 424 42-WEBSERV — Our personal webserv for Milestone 5. Stand proud Nginx, you are strong...
EH 422 42-FT_SHMUP — Our own ft_shmup for the Rushes. Pew pew, shoot 'em all!
EH 421 42-LIBUNIT — Our own libunit for the Rushes. Life is better with a testing framework.
SU 957 SPINUP — Build your own web-apps in a single command. 100% customisable.
EH 429 42-CPP_09 — My tenth module for Milestone 5. Let's use the whole STL with containers.
EH 421 42-CUB3D — Our own cub3d for Milestone 4. Our first RayCasting program in C, with the MiniLibX.
EH 426 42-PHILOSOPHERS — My personal Philosophers for Milestone 3. Resolving the Dining Philosophers problem with multi-threading (mutexes).
EH 421 42-MINISHELL — Our own minishell for Milestone 3. A reproduction of the bash environment with its command interpretation.
THANK YOU FOR FLYING EHOSTA
